title: Choose Your Evening
prompt:
Design a fictional restaurant-reservations example for this task: 
          Start with your visit, then choose the atmosphere. A preference is not a confirmed
          reservation.
         A form-first booking desk puts the request beside a vertical seating preference rail; access details remain directly below the zone choices. Preserve the supplied data, keyboard controls, recovery actions and local-only behavior. Use Poppins and a #F4EAF5 page with #58345C accents.
